label: Tailscale
description: Sign in to Tailscale and grant access to private services. Your cloud computer only makes outgoing connections.

apps.label: Tailnet
apps.description: Reach explicitly granted peer services through your dedicated Tailscale node.

connectPrompt: Choose Connect and sign in on Tailscale. Then configure service access for the connected account.

tools.name: tailscale_list_peers
tools.description: List peers visible to this connection, with granted service operations. When multiple Tailnet accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Tailnet account email or identifier.

tools.name: tailscale_ping
tools.description: Check TCP reachability of a granted peer service. When multiple Tailnet accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Tailnet account email or identifier.

tools.name: tailscale_request
tools.description: Call an explicitly granted HTTP operation on a peer service. Requires read/write access even for GET, because arbitrary services may change state on GET. When multiple Tailnet accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

path.description: Exact granted path including query string.

body.description: Optional request body, at most 512 KiB.

account_email.description: Optional connected Tailnet account email or identifier.
